required_reviews.scope: selection universe, comparator rules, exclusions, privacy boundaries, target-removal test, plausible alternative universes
case denominators, evidence classes, temporal rules, source attrition, falsifiers, ordinary controls, synthesis thresholds
every factual sentence, evidence packet, receipt role, date, allowed language, counterevidence, and limitation
cross-case recurrence, alternative explanations, chapter logic, thesis wording, and whether the evidence supports, weakens, contradicts, or leaves the thesis inconclusive

rules: CI success is not a review.
An author cannot be the independent reviewer of the declaration they authored.
A review may accept, require revision, contest, reject, or declare a question inconclusive.
Pending and adverse review states remain visible in generated dossiers.
No machine process may convert review absence into approval.
